# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4331 # Review — PAN-4331 ## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — `pan vault rotate-key` still receives Commander's `Command` as `io`; the #4407 fix on this branch is incomplete ## Context - Run ID: agent-pan-4331-review-d4b87222 - Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4331/.pan/review/agent-pan-4331-review-d4b87222/context.json - Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4331 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4331 - PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4421 - HEAD reviewed: d4b87222afbb537aac1e0d273d0a28e155d4e8e6 - Base / prior cycle SHA: merge base b5dcbd4a9e5da9a792c8aa1e51ed08e1e979fc55; no prior review cycle ## Blocking Findings ### [correctness] `rotate-key` still receives Commander's `Command` as `io` — `src/cli/commands/vault/index.ts:63` - Severity: `!` - Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope. The PR rewrote `registerVaultCommands` to route every vault verb through the new `vaultAction` wrapper (the #4407 fix). The `rotate-key` registration is the one `.action(lazyAction(...))` left in that function. It reached the branch from `main` (PAN-4333, #4414, present at merge base `b5dcbd4a9e5`), so the fix did not cover it. - Trigger and changed-code connection: `pan vault rotate-key [--yes] [--no-passphrase | --passphrase-file

]`. `rotate-key` has no positionals, so Commander calls the action with `(options, command)`. `lazyAction` forwards both, so `rotateKeyCommand(options, io = command)` runs with a `Command` object as `io`. - Expected / observed / impact: expected, the same behavior as the other 16 verbs after this PR. Observed at HEAD: - With the vault off, the verb throws `TypeError: io.out is not a function` instead of printing the "vault is off" message. - With a configured vault, `--yes`, and either `--no-passphrase`, `--passphrase-file`, or no existing wrap, every `io.*` call before `rotateVaultKey` sits on an error path. The rotation completes and re-encrypts the vault under a new key. Then the first `io.out` (`rotate-key.ts` lines 167–171) throws before `keyToPhrase(result.newKey)` prints. The new recovery phrase is shown only at that moment, so the user never sees it. With `--no-passphrase`, that phrase is the only way for another machine to join. - The PR's durable record overclaims. `.pan/drafts/PAN-4331.md` line 325 says #4407 "is fixed on this branch", and the first #4331 comment says the same. #4407's title says "every verb", and its AC requires that "no vault verb receives a Commander `Command` argument". `tests/unit/cli/vault/cli-wiring.test.ts` covers only `list` and `setup`, so it cannot catch this. - Evidence: isolated runtime probe (scratchpad, `HOME`/`OVERDECK_HOME` set to an empty temp dir, `registerVaultCommands` from HEAD source run through `parseAsync`): ``` vault rotate-key --yes => THREW io.out is not a function Session Vault is off. Run: pan vault setup vault list => ok ``` I traced the post-rotation throw statically through `rotateKeyCommand` (`src/cli/commands/vault/rotate-key.ts` lines 92–180) and `planKeywrap` / `readPassphrase` (`shared.ts` lines 119–122). I did not run a live rotation against a real vault. CodeRabbit flagged the same line as Major (outside the diff range); this finding comes from my own trace. - Fix: change line 63 to `.action(vaultAction(() => import('./rotate-key.js'), 'rotateKeyCommand'))`. Extend `tests/unit/cli/vault/cli-wiring.test.ts` to cover `rotate-key`, or better, iterate over every registered `vault` leaf command and assert that none receives a `Command`, so #4407's AC holds for any verb added later. Keep PRD line 325 true. ## Non-blocking Findings - `~` [requirements] **The PRD's deviations paragraph omits two workflow changes** (`.pan/drafts/PAN-4331.md` line 277; `.github/workflows/windows-smoke.yml` lines 96–100). The `windows` job uses `timeout-minutes: 35` (W5 says 25) and adds the third matrix leg `pwsh-autocrlf-false`. The workflow header comment and the Results section describe the diagnostic leg, but the deviations paragraph does not list either change. CodeRabbit raised the same point. NFR-4 (a run within 45 minutes) is not guaranteed by the per-job timeouts under either value: 20+10+35+5 = 70 minutes worst case, and the PRD's own 20+10+30+5 is 65. The real run finished well inside 45 minutes. - `~` [correctness / harness] **A missing environment disappears instead of showing as missing** (`windows-smoke.yml` lines 155 and 221; `summarize.mjs` `orderEnvs`). The probe steps use `continue-on-error: true`, the result uploads use `if-no-files-found: warn`, and the summarizer builds its columns only from the files it finds. A probe that dies before its final write therefore drops its column silently. The W6 run was complete, with all four `results-*` artifacts present, so the ACs are met. This is harness hardening for future re-runs. The fix is to make both uploads `if-no-files-found: error`, or to make the summarizer always emit the three expected env columns. - `?` [process] **The `push` trigger has no branch filter** (`windows-smoke.yml` lines 18–21). The squash merge touches `scripts/windows-smoke/**`, so one run will fire on `main` after merge. That matches D-8 (manual or path-triggered, not required) and is not a defect. - `?` [harness] **A large step output could break `record`** (`probe-wsl.sh`). `record` passes evidence through environment variables before trimming it to 4000 characters. An output over about 128 KiB would hit the kernel limit on one argument and fall back to the generic "step body exited" fail record. It did not occur in the run. - Pre-existing / out of scope: #4418, #4419 and #4420 are correctly filed as spike findings. D-9 forbids fixing them here. ## Coverage ### Changed-file ledger | File | Status | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | configuration/session-vault.mdx | reviewed | `## Windows` placed before `## Where things live`; names the environment, date and run link; WSL2 supported, native not; matches the W9 rule and the results table; states unverified items as unverified. | | .github/workflows/windows-smoke.yml | reviewed | `permissions: contents: read`, no secrets, no `pull_request_target`, only trusted `${{ }}` contexts; every job sets `timeout-minutes`; not in ci.yml and not required. Advisories above. | | scripts/windows-smoke/probe-wsl.sh | reviewed | Each step runs in a subshell with `set +e` (NFR-1); every catalogue id is emitted once with a fallback; B-flow runs in `~/w/proj` in the Linux filesystem; 5a is judged from `uname -r`. | | scripts/windows-smoke/probe.ps1 | reviewed | `Invoke-Step` try/catch; stdin closed with timeouts; missing ids filled; UTF-8 without BOM; cascade demotes 4b–4f when 4a fails; writes stay under `RUNNER_TEMP` and the user home (NFR-2). | | scripts/windows-smoke/summarize.mjs | reviewed | Escapes pipes, truncates to 120 characters, marks a missing step `missing`, fence length adapts to backticks in the evidence. | | src/cli/commands/vault/index.ts | reviewed | `vaultAction` is correct for all 16 wrapped verbs, including `save --hook` and `resume`. BLOCKER: `rotate-key` not wrapped. | | src/cli/lazy-action.ts | reviewed | Only exports the `ActionKeys` type; no behavior change. | | .pan/continues/PAN-4331.xbrief.json | reviewed (n/a) | Plan state artifact. | | .pan/drafts/PAN-4331.md | reviewed | Results table, blocking list and deviations are present. Line 325 overclaims the #4407 fix; line 277 omits the timeout and leg deviations. | | .pan/drafts/pan-3762.md | reviewed | NFR-9 sentence appended; nothing renumbered. | | .pan/specs/…PAN-4331…xbrief.json | reviewed (n/a) | Plan spec artifact; consistent with the PRD. | | docs/SESSION-VAULT.md | reviewed | `## Windows` appended at the end; consistent with the run evidence. | | scripts/windows-smoke/make-fixture.sh | reviewed | Isolated `HOME`; `env -i` for pan; fixed test passphrase (NFR-3); fails loudly if `appended` or the list row is missing. | | tests/unit/cli/vault/cli-wiring.test.ts | reviewed | Correct for `list` and `setup`; does not cover all verbs (see blocker). | | tests/unit/scripts/windows-smoke-summarize.test.ts | reviewed | Covers a pass, an escaped pipe in a fail, a missing step and the details block; no delays. | ### Dimensions - **Correctness:** one blocker (`rotate-key`). The harness logic is sound. The scripts are byte-identical between the results run's subject `cdcef07` and HEAD (`git diff --stat cdcef07eb0a HEAD -- scripts/windows-smoke .github/workflows/windows-smoke.yml` shows no changes), so the results table describes the shipped probes. - **Security:** no findings. The workflow has read-only permissions and uses no credentials (NFR-3, non-goal 5). Evidence posted to the issue comes from our own CI. The fixture passphrase is a throwaway test string by design (D-5). - **Performance:** not applicable to the product. The `vaultAction` wrapper adds one array slice per CLI call. On the harness side, `npm install --prefix` once avoids re-extracting the tarball per call. - **Requirements / UX:** all nine plan items are met (matrix below). The `src/` change deviates from D-9 and non-goal 1. It is disclosed on #4331 and filed as #4407, but the fix is incomplete. ### Acceptance criteria | AC | Status | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 fixture script (W1) | met | `fixture` job passed in runs 36615182191 and 36619604113; the script asserts the list row itself. | | 2 Windows results complete (W2) | met | `results-windows-pwsh` and `results-windows-gitbash` artifacts exist for run 36615182191; the probe fills every catalogue id; every fail cell in the PRD table carries evidence. | | 3 WSL results complete (W3) | met | `results-wsl2` artifact exists; the table shows all 20 ids. | | 4 summarizer unit test (W4) | met | `tests/unit/scripts/windows-smoke-summarize.test.ts` passed (4 tests) in CI `test-shard (1/4)` at HEAD. | | 5 workflow completes, uploads table (W5) | met | Run 36615182191 `completed success`; artifacts include `windows-smoke-table`. | | 6 results posted and in the PRD (W6) | met | #4331 comment "PAN-4331 results: windows-smoke run 36615182191"; PRD `## Results` section. | | 7 blockers filed (W7) | met | #4418, #4419 and #4420 are open with titles naming the component; #4331 lists them. 2b was correctly judged non-blocking because the error names Herdr and the remedy. | | 8 NFR-9 updated (W8) | met | `.pan/drafts/pan-3762.md` NFR-9 edit; matching comment on #3762. | | 9 Windows docs (W9) | met | Both pages have `## Windows` with environment, supported paths, run link and 4d–4f behavior. | | #4407 AC (fix carried on this branch) | unmet | `rotate-key` still receives a `Command`; the wiring test does not cover all verbs. | ## Verification - CI at HEAD `d4b87222` (PR #4421 `gh pr checks`): build, lint, all four `lint-group`s, test shards 1–4, test-e2e, pack, clean install smoke, and `overdeck/test` (verification gate) passed. - `lint:effect-diagnostics`: covered by `lint-group (effect)`, which passed at HEAD (`scripts/run-lint-group.mjs` maps `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics` to `effect`). - New tests are in the normal test command: `windows-smoke-summarize.test.ts` ran in `test-shard (1/4)` and `cli/vault/cli-wiring.test.ts` in `test-shard (2/4)`, both green. - windows-smoke run 36619604113 on HEAD: `pack`, `fixture` and `wsl` passed; the three `windows (…)` legs were still in progress at review time. They are not required checks (non-goal 4) and do not gate AC-5, which is met by run 36615182191. - Runtime probe: the `rotate-key` / `list` wiring probe shown above, run from the scratchpad with an isolated empty `HOME`/`OVERDECK_HOME`. - Not run: the full test suite (per role); a live `rotate-key` against a real vault (the impact after rotation comes from the static trace). ## Scope Note The branch changes `src/` despite D-9 and non-goal 1 ("no changes under src/"). The author disclosed this on #4331 and filed #4407: without the fix, the fixture cannot be built. I treat it as acknowledged, not as a new finding. #4407 must not be closed on this PR's merge until `rotate-key` is wrapped and the wiring test covers every vault verb. Source: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4331/.pan/review/agent-pan-4331-review-d4b87222/review.md ## Required action Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with: `pan review request PAN-4331 -m "Fixed review issues"`
